episodes.title: पार्वती जी की कथा: करवा चौथ में वीरावती की परीक्षा
episodes.description: एक सच्ची भक्ती की कहानी जहाँ वीरावती के व्रत को भाईयों ने छल से तोड़ा, पति को मृत्यु की कगार पर ले आया, और माँ पार्वती की कृपा से जीवन मिला। सुनिए इस अद्भुत कथा को और पाएँ आशीर्वाद।
episodes.summary: On the eve of Karva Chauth, Queen Veeravati (वीरावती) prepares to begin her fast, her heart filled with love and resolve to protect her husband, the King (राजा). As the moon rises, her mischievous brothers (भाई) conspire, presenting a false moon to tempt her to break the vrata. The moment she tastes the sweet, the King collapses, lifeless, and darkness spreads over the palace. Veeravati, devastated, refuses to accept defeat and vows a year‑long devotion to Maa Parvati (पार्वती). She spends each day in prayer, offering flowers, chanting mantras, and performing austerities, while the kingdom watches her unwavering faith. The brothers, remorseful, witness her steadfastness and pray for her husband's return, hoping her devotion will move the divine. At the end of the year, Parvati appears in radiant form—dark complexion, green sari, three eyes, holding a trident and lotus—and grants Veeravati’s plea. The King awakens, restored to life, and the kingdom rejoices, honoring the power of a wife's devotion. The story closes with a blessing: may every Karva Chauth be filled with love, faith, and divine grace.
